reviews.author: franco desantis
reviews.text: Noticed a leak and Landon inspected the roof the same day. Roof was 24 years old and near end of use. Landon gave an estimate which was very fair and the next week new roof was installed in 1 day with excellent clean up

reviews.author: Michael andra
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Landon and his company! We had our roof replaced as part of an insurance claim, and Landon completely took over the process from start to finish. I hardly had to deal with the insurance side of things at all, which took a huge amount of stress and work off my plate.

Once everything was approved, Landon and his crew got the roof done right away. They did an excellent job, cleaned everything up when they were finished, and left absolutely no mess behind. He even took care of the roof on my shed at no additional charge, which I really appreciated.

The new roof looks amazing, and the quality of work was excellent. On top of that, I had looked at other companies around town, and some were nearly double what Landon charged.

Great communication, great workmanship, fair pricing, and he made the entire insurance process incredibly easy. I would absolutely use Landon again and recommend him to anyone needing a roof. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Mike Garzarelli
reviews.text:
These guys are top notch and their work is great!
Thank you again for helping me out of the pinch I was in🤙 You are now my only call for roofing needs.

reviews.author: Katie Conwell
reviews.text: Landon came out to our townhome to inspect a roof leak and was able to get on the roof, find the issue, and fix it quickly. He was professional, helpful, and made the process easy from start to finish. We really appreciated how responsive and knowledgeable he was. I would definitely recommend Frame Restoration Utah to anyone needing a reliable roofing contractor in Hideout, Utah.
